_doc: FIX REPORTED, FIX LANDED, FIX VERIFIED, FIX GENERALIZED are four different states; we do not collapse them. VERIFIED requires independent evidence that already existed before the claiming commit. GENERALIZED requires VERIFIED plus disjoint authored-against and generalized-on surfaces. STRUCTURAL RULE (2026-09-14): NOT-A-FIX is decided by what the commit changes (only docs/evidence/ and prose may be NOT-A-FIX), never by words in the subject; the first version keyed on subject words and refused an evidence-only commit whose subject said 'CI refusing a leak'.

mislabelled_under_prior_rule.why: NOT-A-FIX while changing harness/fixstate.py and a test (evidence move); the subject-word rule allowed it
NOT-A-FIX while changing .github/workflows/verify.yml (CI key wiring); the subject-word rule allowed it
